about: A Sheet Document: what it carries, what it refuses of a version that does not define it, and what round-trips through its JSON, every bit of a number included (ADR-0046, ADR-0047, ADR-0048, SH-12, SH-21). A document's JSON is read as text. Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' SheetDocumentTests.

steps.note: A number typed into a percent cell is a percentage (ADR-0047, second run).

cases.name: ADR-0048 (SH-12, SH-17): a document holds no Values; the engine alone computes the same ones again
ADR-0048: a number round-trips exactly through the document, every bit
ADR-0048: text with any characters round-trips
ADR-0048, ADR-0046: a version 1 document still opens, as a Sheet named Sheet1, and is written at the current version
ADR-0048, ADR-0047: a version 2 document still opens; its cells' formats are the cells' own
ADR-0047 (SH-21): formats on whole columns and rows are one entry each, adjacent ones one run, and round-trip
ADR-0046: the Sheet's name round-trips, and a Reference qualified with it reads the Sheet when reopened
ADR-0048: the invariant culture can be declared and recorded too
